name: Anas ibn Malik
nameAr: أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه
diedNote: died 91–93 AH, the last Companion to die in Basra
bio: Served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years from boyhood and lived to be among the very last Companions. Because he lived so long and so many narrated from him, many weak and fabricating narrators later claimed to have heard him, which is why the critics checked reports “from Anas” with particular care.
